notes.title: 48 hour Half Price Sale
notes.content:
[h3]HALF PRICE SALE!![/h3]

In celebration of the first International Gamebook Day on Aug 27th, we're having a [b]48 hour half price sale.[/b]

Our game is closely based on the original gamebook of Deathtrap Dungeon, released in 1984.

[b]Get in quick for this flash discount[/b]
